column3: Motion rebuilt on the v5 handoff file web/src/styles/ingle-motion.css (verbatim), replacing the §7 rules of the first pass: call sites use .im-* and .sig, motion.css shrinks to app glue, status.css and the d-* glyph animations are gone, StatusGlyph renders .sig, overview sections drop Ark Collapsible for .im-grow, the pane pill is an absolute .im-pill (translate and width), keyboard-started actions get data-instant on the element
column4: design system §0.8 makes the file the source of truth; .im-press and .im-hover each set the transition shorthand, so an element with both needs a combined rule; the file has no left-edge sheet; a MutationObserver alone could not make the pane swap instant because the pill's offsetLeft read forced style before its microtask, so components that render the element set data-instant themselves and the observer covers Ark overlays
column5: Playwright Chromium against the Worker on 8799: pop 150/100, dialog 200/140, scrim 200, pane 150, pill 200 in-out, grow 200/140 with content +60ms, chevron 200, sig chase 960ms, hidden tab pauses, reduce gives 120ms fades and a still ink-3 shimmer, keyboard pane switch and pill run with no transition
